scope: GAP-01: picker completion and responsive import feedback
authorization: Current user request to fix file picker hangs and import progress stalls.
status: implemented; offline checks passed; native interaction verification pending
findings: Progress previously began at a fixed 15 percent without read or parse updates.
Pinned rfd 0.15.4 ThreadFuture has a possible lost-wakeup interval; it is a code-level finding, not a reproduced cause of the reported native-window delay.
implementation: Parented synchronous file picker on a blocking worker; completion precedes import.
Incremental 256 KiB reads; parser reports processed UTF-8 bytes every 256 lines and at completion.
Progress events are limited to phase/percentage changes. Non-measured phases use activity animation. IPC response gates frontend completion.
Single picker/import guard, progress subscription before import, and late-event/unmount protection.
The active path now propagates cache/database save failures instead of reporting success. Existing database transaction design was not changed.

checks.warning: Vite reports mixed static/dynamic imports of Tauri core; build succeeds.

limitations: No actual native file dialog interaction or user-file latency measurement was performed.
Frontend tests use deterministic mocked IPC and lifecycle hooks, not a rendered browser or WebView.
No intensive coverage/mutation/fault-injection qualification or formal development gate was computed.
No service stop/start, commit, push, dependency download, or production data migration was invoked.
